$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.check.common.unused. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-CONFINEMENT-REPORT-INDEX-PARAM
arms.note: the removability proof asks the REPORT index again, so an `@:access` grantee outside the lint scope is invisible, the private method reads as confined and the finding goes back to `Warning` — the severity that REMOVES the parameter its cross-file callers still pass

arms.name: M-CONFINEMENT-REPORT-INDEX-DEAD
arms.find: final scopeIndex: SymbolIndex = IndexScope.widestScopeIndex(plugin, index) ?? index;
arms.note: the S177 site, declared as an arm only in S180: the zero-occurrence proof asks the REPORT index again, so an `@:access` grantee outside the lint scope is invisible and a live private member is reported dead — and then deleted

arms.name: M-UNUSED-PRIVATE-DECLINE-SILENT
arms.note: the seven per-member gates go back to a bare `false`: `--fix` still refuses the member and the ledger still counts it declined, with no sentence saying which gate closed

arms.name: M-UNUSED-PRIVATE-REGION-DECLINE-SILENT
arms.find:
declined.declineReason = 'every member of its `#if` branch would go with it, and emptying a conditional region '
				+ 'loses the branch itself';
arms.note: the one gate that is a fact about the edit SET rather than about a member — a `#if` branch this call would empty — stops speaking, which is the site the T865 brief did not enumerate

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-NEVER
arms.note: every string spelling a private static's name keeps it, whatever can reach the class — the old gate

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-INSTANCE
arms.note: an instance member takes the static-only relaxation, although instances flow into Dynamic everywhere

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-VALUE-BLIND
arms.note: the class name read as a value is ignored, so `Reflect.field(C, name)` through a local is not seen

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-CONSUMER-NONE
arms.note: no consumer is whitelisted, so `Type.getClassName(Type.getClass(x))` reads as an escape and nothing is ever relaxed

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-SOURCE-BLIND
arms.note: an unconsumed `Type.getClass` / `typeof` / `resolveClass` is ignored, so an instance's class value reaches reflection unseen

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-THIS-UNBOUNDED
arms.note: `getClass(this)` opens every class instead of the enclosing chain, so an unrelated class's self-lookup keeps every static

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-THIS-BLIND
arms.note: `getClass(this)` in a superclass of the owner is ignored, although `this` may be an owner instance

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-SUBTYPE-BLIND
arms.find: for (sub in index.subtypes.subtypeNames(owner, ownerFile)) if (!chain.contains(sub)) chain.push(sub);
arms.note: a subclass's class value is ignored, although eval and ES6 js expose the inherited static through it

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-ALIAS-BLIND
arms.note: a typedef or import alias of the owner read as a value is ignored

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-TYPEPATH-BLIND
arms.note: a literal naming the owner's path is ignored, so `Type.resolveClass('pkg.C')` or a library wrapper handed it is not seen

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-JS-HANDLE-BLIND
arms.note: `o.__class__` / `o.constructor` is ignored, although js reaches the instance's class through it

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-RECEIVER-BLIND
arms.note: `C.ext()` naming no member of C is read as a static access, although a `using` extension then receives the class

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-MACRO-BLIND
arms.note: a string in a macro file is vouched for, although reification turns it into an identifier

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-CARRIER-BLIND
arms.note: a string pasted into target code is vouched for, although it names the static directly

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-OPAQUE-SOURCE-BLIND
arms.find: if (state.opaque.exists(text -> handles.exists(h -> RawSourceScan.mentionsWord(text, h)))) state.escapesAll = true;
arms.note: a `Type.getClass` inside an unparsed `#if` region is ignored, although no node walk sees it

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-OPAQUE-CHAIN-BLIND
arms.note: the owner's name inside an unparsed `#if` region is ignored, although it may be the class value handed to reflection

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-REIFY-BLIND
arms.note: a project macro reifying the class it builds or is called from is ignored, so a registry it feeds reaches the static unseen

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-MACRO-THIS
arms.note: `getClass(this)` inside a macro module is bounded by the module's class, although `this` is reified into the caller

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-DEFINITION-BLIND
arms.note: a name-taking class source — `Type.resolveClass` or a library `getDefinitionByName` — is not recognised, so one handed a computed name escapes unseen

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-SOURCE-STRING-BLIND
arms.note: a string naming a class source is ignored, so a reflective call of `Type.getClass` escapes unseen

arms.name: M-STATICREACH-USING-STD-ASSUMED
arms.note: any receiver-less `x.isOfType(v)` is taken for `Std.isOfType`, although without `using Std` it is some method handed the class

arms.name: M-CTOR-CLASS-VALUE-BLIND
arms.note: a class handed around as a value is still never-instantiated, so the constructor `Type.createInstance` runs is deleted

arms.name: M-CTOR-RECEIVER-AS-VALUE
arms.note: a static access `U.K` counts as a class value, so no utility class's private constructor is reported

arms.name: M-CTOR-ALIAS-BLIND
arms.note: a typedef aliasing the class is ignored, so a class value spelled by the alias reaches a deleted constructor

arms.name: M-CTOR-IMPORT-ALIAS-BLIND
arms.note: an import alias of the class is not a spelling of it, so `Type.createInstance(K, [])` reaches a deleted constructor

arms.name: M-CTOR-QUALIFIED-BLIND
arms.note: a qualified path to the class is not a class value, so `Type.createInstance(pkg.U, [])` reaches a deleted constructor

arms.name: M-UNUSED-PRIVATE-CHAIN-FACTS
arms.note: every private method of an `extends` class stays, whatever the compiler's facts say of its supertypes

arms.name: M-UNUSED-BINDER-UNPROVEN
arms.find: if (!CasePatternScan.provesCapture(seams, root, switchNode, arm, group[0], scope)) continue;
arms.note: an unread binder that may be a constant is spelled `_`, which turns a comparison into a catch-all

arms.name: M-UNUSED-LOCAL-IMPURE-UNSAID
arms.find: v.declineReason = 'the initializer is not provably side-effect-free, so deleting the declaration would drop whatever '
arms.replace: final unsaid: String = 'the initializer is not provably side-effect-free, so deleting the declaration would drop whatever '
arms.note: the side-effecting-initializer refusal names no reason in the --fix ledger

arms.name: M-UNUSED-LOCAL-SHARED-LINE-UNSAID
arms.find: v.declineReason = 'the binding shares its declaration line with another one, and the deletion takes the whole line';
arms.replace: final unsaid: String = 'the binding shares its declaration line with another one, and the deletion takes the whole line';
arms.note: the shared-line refusal names no reason in the --fix ledger

arms.name: M-UNUSED-PRIVATE-FIELD-KIND-PURITY
arms.note: a field initializer is judged kind-only again, so a pure collection literal or stdlib call keeps a dead field

arms.name: M-UNUSED-PRIVATE-CHAIN-NOT-RESOLVED
arms.note: a resolution-scope proof that no supertype declares the name is not taken, so every private method of a subclass stays undeletable without compiler facts (three client classes)

arms.name: M-DEADSTORE-OWN-PURITY
arms.note: the dead-store fix proves nothing beyond the shape, so a dead `s.toUpperCase()` / `Date.now()` / `Std.int(v)` store stays

arms.name: M-DEADSTORE-RETURN-EXPR
arms.note: a return inside an expression is read as a throw a catch may intercept, so every local stays live at it and the dead stores before it go unreported

arms.name: M-QUALIFIED-CONSTRUCTION-UNSEEN
arms.note: a qualified `new pkg.Type()` is not a construction of `Type`, so a private constructor only built that way is deleted

arms.name: M-CTOR-PRIVILEGE-UNASKED
arms.note: the constructor arm stops asking what a privilege reaches, so a private constructor built through a waived alias or referenced as `A.new` is deleted
